# get_wall_windows3 { #mofography.compute.get_wall_windows3 }

```python
compute.get_wall_windows3(regions, maxima, dgrid, ase_atoms, wall_thickness)
```

This function calculates the wall windows based on the provided regions, maxima, dgrid, and other parameters.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                | Default    |
|----------------|--------|--------------------------------------------|------------|
| regions        |        | The labeled regions from the segmentation. | _required_ |
| maxima         |        | The maxima points in the dgrid.            | _required_ |
| dgrid          |        | The dgrid data.                            | _required_ |
| ase_atoms      |        | The ASE atoms object.                      | _required_ |
| wall_thickness |        | The thickness of the wall to consider.     | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description             |
|--------|--------|-------------------------|
|        |        | A list of wall windows. |
